w00-arrive.observed_description: Ana in her green overshirt steps off a silver train with her dark-blue suitcase into a big glass-roofed station with a city skyline beyond.
w00-arrive.note: Usable: mission kickoff, Ana arrives in the city.

w01-station.observed_description: A wide station hall: a man in a green jacket runs with a briefcase toward a train; a woman in yellow reads on a bench; a man with a suitcase steps into a train door; a woman in purple takes a ticket at a ticket window.
w01-station.note: Usable: four separate targets for late, early, on time and buying a ticket.

w02-street.observed_description: A row of town shops: a bakery, a bookstore, a brick building with a plain white car, a gas station.
w02-street.note: REJECTED: the car has no light bar, so the brick building does not read as a police station; remade as v2 w07.

w03-signs.observed_description: Four vertical panels: a no-swimming sign, a no-bikes sign, a no-photos sign and a second no-photos sign by a bench.
w03-signs.note: REJECTED: a four-panel collage, and the bench has a sign; remade as v2 w08.

w04-hotel.observed_description: A wide hotel lobby: a woman in red at the desk with a receptionist; a man in brown takes a key; a man in blue with a suitcase by the elevator; through a door a grey-haired woman sits on a hotel bed.
w04-hotel.note: Usable: four separate targets for reservation, key, elevator and room.

w05-clerk.observed_description: A ticket clerk with glasses in a grey shirt looks at the camera from behind a station ticket window; a blurred departures board behind.
w05-clerk.note: Usable: the voice-gate clerk; the board is blurred and unreadable at runtime size.

w06-desk.observed_description: A hotel receptionist with a dark braid and navy blazer looks at the camera behind a wooden desk.
